free.label: REFLUX FREE v1.0.23
free.message: RAM update. The Performance & Info tab now shows your real rated vs running memory speed and only flags a memory profile when your PC can actually change it, so laptops no longer get a warning they cannot act on. Clear Standby List now does a real standby purge instead of nothing, and page file sizing scales to your installed RAM. Also fixes hardware detection failing outright on some PCs, and the live chart and CPU/GPU/RAM panel now sit at the top of the home page.

pro.label: REFLUX PRO v1.0.32
pro.message: Big RAM update. The Performance & Info tab now shows your real rated vs running memory speed, and works out whether your PC can actually take a BIOS memory profile — laptops no longer get a warning they cannot act on. Desktops get a step-by-step guide with the exact menu path for your detected board. Clear Standby List now does a real standby purge instead of nothing, page file sizing scales to your installed RAM, and four new memory tweaks were added. Also fixes hardware detection failing outright on some PCs, and the live chart and CPU/GPU/RAM panel now sit at the top of the home page.
